name: EPIC 212006252
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 11.4 solar radii and 1.08 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212006252 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.398694 (16th-84th percentiles 10.807705-11.928475), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212006252: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4736.102 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212006252 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 5184.0625 (16th-84th percentiles 4990-5365.234375), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.24 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 5,184 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.08 solar masses and 11.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,736 K at its surface.
